question: An engineer is implementing zoning on two Cisco MDS switches. After the implementation is finished, E Ports that connect the two Cisco MDS switches become isolated. What is wrong with the implementation?
context: Zoning was configured with Zoneset AB, containing different active zone set names between MDS-A and MDS-B.
options: Zones are local to the MDS switch and name service must be used to activate the connection between E Ports.
Different zone set names must be configured on both MDS switches.
Zones must have the same name on both MDS switches for the E Ports to function.
E Ports on both MDS switches must be configured as F Ports for the zoning to function.
